# Fields & networks

*Describes silverpoint 0.8.0.*

5 charts. Shared props, the data shapes and the recommender are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md).

**Contents:** [DensityBinChart](#densitybinchart) · [ContourChart](#contourchart) · [DelaunayChart](#delaunaychart) · [VectorFieldChart](#vectorfieldchart) · [NetworkChart](#networkchart)

## DensityBinChart

`density-bin-chart` · X-y points counted in two-dimensional bins.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `DensityBinChart` | `SpDensityBinChart` | `sp-density-bin-chart` | `density_bin_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/density-bin-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/density-bin-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/density-bin-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `points`; intents `distribution`, `correlation`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| x | `xKey` | number | yes |
| y | `yKey` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows (read through xKey="x", yKey="y"), drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "x": 18.48, "y": 44.44 }, { "x": 38.26, "y": 64.71 }, { "x": 39.92, "y": 61.68 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'x'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `yKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'y'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `binShape` | `'hexagon' \| 'rect'` |  |  |
| `binSize` | `number` | `14` | Bin size in px; 14 by default. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { DensityBinChart } from '@silverpoint/react/density-bin-chart';

export function DensityBinChartView({ rows }: { rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }) {
  return (
    <DensityBinChart
      data={rows}
      xKey="x"
      yKey="y"
      title="Density bin chart"
    />
  );
}
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { SpDensityBinChart } from '@silverpoint/vue/density-bin-chart';

defineProps<{ rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <SpDensityBinChart
    :data="rows"
    xKey="x"
    yKey="y"
    title="Density bin chart"
  />
</template>
```

```ts angular
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, input } from '@angular/core';
import { SpDensityBinChart } from '@silverpoint/angular/density-bin-chart';

/** Add '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css', '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css' to the `styles` of angular.json. */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-density-bin-chart-view',
  imports: [SpDensityBinChart],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <sp-density-bin-chart
      [data]="rows()"
      [xKey]="'x'"
      [yKey]="'y'"
      [title]="'Density bin chart'"
    />
  `,
})
export class DensityBinChartView {
  readonly rows = input.required<readonly Record<string, unknown>[]>();
}
```

## ContourChart

`contour-chart` · Iso-lines and filled bands of a density or a grid.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `ContourChart` | `SpContourChart` | `sp-contour-chart` | `contour_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/contour-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/contour-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/contour-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `points`; intents `distribution`, `correlation`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| x | `xKey` | number | yes |
| y | `yKey` | number | yes |
| value | `valueKey` | number | no |

The demo's first rows (read through xKey="x", yKey="y"), drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "x": 18.48, "y": 44.44 }, { "x": 38.26, "y": 64.71 }, { "x": 39.92, "y": 61.68 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | `'points' \| 'grid'` |  | `points` estimates a density from a point cloud; `grid` reads a regular grid of values. |
| `xKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'x'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `yKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'y'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `valueKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'value'` | The grid value (`source: 'grid'`). Ignored without `data`. |
| `levels` | `number \| readonly number[]` |  | A count of levels, or the thresholds, increasing: in the grid's values, or as shares of the density's peak. Ignored without `data`. |
| `filled` | `boolean` | `true` | Fills the bands between levels; `true` by default. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { ContourChart } from '@silverpoint/react/contour-chart';

export function ContourChartView({ rows }: { rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }) {
  return (
    <ContourChart
      data={rows}
      xKey="x"
      yKey="y"
      title="Contour chart"
    />
  );
}
```


## DelaunayChart

`delaunay-chart` · The triangulation of x-y points, or its Voronoi cells.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `DelaunayChart` | `SpDelaunayChart` | `sp-delaunay-chart` | `delaunay_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/delaunay-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/delaunay-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/delaunay-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `points`; intents `network`, `distribution`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| x | `xKey` | number | yes |
| y | `yKey` | number | yes |
| label | `labelKey` | string | no |

The demo's first rows (read through xKey="x", yKey="y", labelKey="label"), drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "label": "P01", "x": 45, "y": 27.3 }, { "label": "P02", "x": 37.4, "y": 55.6 }, { "label": "P03", "x": 90.6, "y": 39.1 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'x'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `yKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'y'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `labelKey` | `Accessor<string \| null \| undefined>` |  | Ignored without `data`. |
| `mesh` | `'delaunay' \| 'voronoi'` |  |  |

### Example

## VectorFieldChart

`vector-field-chart` · An arrow per grid point.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `VectorFieldChart` | `SpVectorFieldChart` | `sp-vector-field-chart` | `vector_field_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/vector-field-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/vector-field-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/vector-field-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `field`; intents `flow`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| x | `xKey` | number | yes |
| y | `yKey` | number | yes |
| u | `uKey` | number | yes |
| v | `vKey` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows (read through xKey="x", yKey="y", uKey="u", vKey="v"), drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "x": 0, "y": 0, "u": 0.852, "v": -1.246 }, { "x": 1, "y": 0, "u": 0.967, "v": -1.264 }, { "x": 2, "y": 0, "u": 1.097, "v": -1.266 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'x'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `yKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'y'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `uKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'u'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `vKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'v'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `scale` | `number` |  | Arrow length per unit of magnitude; fitted to the grid by default. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
```

```ts angular
}
```

## NetworkChart

`network-chart` · A node-link graph.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `NetworkChart` | `SpNetworkChart` | `sp-network-chart` | `network_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/network-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/network-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/network-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `links`; intents `network`, `flow`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| source | `sourceKey` | string | yes |
| target | `targetKey` | string | yes |
| value | `valueKey` | number | no |

The demo's first rows (read through sourceKey="source", targetKey="target", valueKey="weight"), drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "source": "s05", "target": "s02", "weight": 5 }, { "source": "p10", "target": "a06", "weight": 1 }, { "source": "p01", "target": "p07", "weight": 5 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sourceKey` | `Accessor<string>` | `'source'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `targetKey` | `Accessor<string>` | `'target'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `valueKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `1` | 1 by default. Ignored without `data`. |
| `nodes` | `readonly NetworkNode[]` |  | The nodes, as data; the distinct ends of the links by default. Ignored without `data`. |
| `iterations` | `number` | `300` | Layout iterations; 300 by default. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';

export function NetworkChartView({ rows }: { rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }) {

      data={rows}
      sourceKey="source"
      targetKey="target"
      valueKey="weight"

}
```
